time_basis: Political control is a date-level historical classification for 6 June 1944. Military positions are approximate snapshots at the stated UTC or local-time basis; no modern border is presented as a 1944 surveyed boundary.

provenance.interpretation: This bounded layer combines source-backed occupation/control labels with deliberately simplified geometry for a world map. Geometry marked estimated is for context and must not be read as an exact 1944 boundary or front line.
provenance.geometry_policy: Political labels remain points. Boundary linework is sourced geometry: shared edges extracted from Natural Earth 50m admin-0 polygons for explicitly named western European pairs. The source is modern; only borders judged stable for the 1944 context are included, with that limitation visible in each feature.

limitations: Military formations are approximate sector anchors on 6 June; no continuous front or minute-by-minute unit movements are inferred.
Neutral status means diplomatic/military status in this layer, not absence of economic or intelligence involvement.
Boundary lines are generalized context segments and should not be mistaken for surveyed 1944 geometry.
No continuous Normandy front line is included; the cited CMH maps should be georeferenced separately if an operational line is required.
Natural Earth is modern geometry, not a dated 1944 boundary dataset. Only explicitly named borders with stable national identity in the wartime context are shown.

natural_earth_source.extraction: shared polygon boundary edges by country NAME; no hand-authored coordinate vertices
